capabilities: insert an inline tally counter at the cursor with Alt+Z
count strokes up and down with Space, Backspace, + and - keys
commit tallies as plain text like 正正正·3 with a hidden count marker
resume committed tallies from their stored total by clicking the chip
render committed tally chips in reading view
disambiguation: Not a word-count or statistics tool; it only counts tally strokes you enter by hand.
extras: Desktop only, no mobile support; no history or statistics. Stroke vector data is under the Arphic Public License, not the plugin's MIT license.
problem: Counting with 正 tallies in Markdown means typing characters by hand, losing track of the count, and having no way to resume a tally later.

relations.plugin: Hanzi Writer Data / Make Me a Hanzi

summary: Inline 正 tally counter that counts stroke by stroke at the cursor and stores resumable tallies as readable text with a hidden marker.
